result_hash_provenance: Computed after the completed run from the local aggregate result; not a runtime signature, a supervisor receipt binding, or an independent timestamp.

scope.source: one previously completed public-seed development game
scope.sample_selection: fixed in the registration before the probe

comparison.passed_means: comparison invariants passed, not competitive improvement
comparison.comparison_boundary: Same ordered input and negated logits are checked through the first divergent task choice only. The later calls may receive different inputs. A changed request was not executed by the official engine.

identity.intervention: negate task output layer w2 and b2 only in memory; no modified checkpoint was saved
identity.post_run_file_hash_checks: The operator and one independent reviewer computed hashes after the run; original checkpoints, certified replay and trace, and default bot matched their frozen identities. These checks are not recorded in the supervisor success receipt.

supervisor.provenance: Receipts and stdout are program reports, not an independent OS monitor. The committed source requires the job limit query and child cleanup to pass before success.
supervisor.not_recorded: Individual memory sample values, memory peak, separate OS job records and a runtime binding of the aggregate result hash.

independent_review.review_scope: Read-only check of source, registration, aggregate result and receipts; one reviewer also checked file hashes.
independent_review.finding: No defect found that invalidates the reported limited comparison; evidence and interpretation limits remain.

limitations: All 32 fixed observations come from one development game; they are not independent games or a held-out competitive panel.
The 20 comparable calls and maximum logit error apply only through the first choice difference; the 116 calls per actor are not 116 same-input comparisons.
A complete request can differ in any action branch; the aggregate result does not attribute it to a particular unit or market action.
The result does not establish the quality of the learned policy, official execution of altered actions, economic improvement, generalization or GPU acceleration.
The local result and supervision receipts are self-reported; their later hashes and independent read-only review do not prove an execution-time signature or third-party timestamp.
